auth.notConfigured: The server is not configured, so you can't sign in yet. See README to connect Supabase and PowerSync.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.signUpIntro: Owners create an account and then their organization. Staff: use the email address your manager invited.
auth.confirmEmailSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
auth.resetIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.linkExpired: That link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

validation.minAboveMax: Must be at least the minimum.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.sameTimes: Start and end can't be the same. Turn on "All day" instead.

errors.already_invited: Someone else already invited this person. Ask the owner.

errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation was not found. It may have been withdrawn.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email address first (check your inbox).
errors.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
errors.invalid_station_type: That station type doesn't belong to this organization.
errors.email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. This needs internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_station: That station isn't in this branch.
errors.station_unavailable: This station is out of service or removed, so it can't be used.
errors.station_busy: Someone is already playing on this station.

errors.booking_conflict: This station is already booked for that time.

errors.invalid_customer: That customer can't be used here.
errors.invalid_product: That product can't be sold here.

roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, in every branch: settings, prices, staff and all reports.
roleDescriptions.manager: Runs their branches: stations, sessions, expenses, branch reports and cashiers.
roleDescriptions.cashier: Sessions, reservations and payments in their branches. No prices or income reports.

onboarding.intro: You're signed in as {{email}}. Join your team's organization or create your own.
onboarding.createIntro: For owners: your gaming center, with its first branch. You can add more branches later.

boot.waitingForConnection: Waiting for internet. The first sign-in on a device needs a connection; after that the app works offline.

home.noBranch: You're not assigned to any branch yet. Ask your manager or the owner.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountHint: Your name, password, language, sign out
settings.stationsHint: PCs and rooms in this branch, maintenance
settings.stationTypesHint: PC desk and PlayStation room types, prices, packages
settings.pricePreviewHint: Check what a session would cost

organization.ownerOnly: Only owners can change these settings.
organization.name: Name
organization.timezoneHint: Used for opening hours, peak prices and reports. Example: Africa/Cairo
organization.featuresIntro: Turning a module off hides it everywhere. Its data is kept.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Name
branches.activeHint: Closed branches are hidden from the branch switcher. Their history is kept.

staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteIntro: They'll get an email to join. If they already have an account, they'll see the invitation when they open the app.
staff.inviteSaved: Invitation saved. Ask {{email}} to sign in (or create an account) with this email to join.
staff.noBranches: Not assigned to any branch: this person can't work anywhere yet.
staff.removeConfirm: They will lose access to all branches. Their past records are kept.

account.title: Account
account.unsyncedWarning: {{count}} change(s) on this device haven't been uploaded yet and will be lost if you sign out now. Connect to the internet and wait for sync, or sign out anyway.

stationTypes.title: Station types & prices
stationTypes.intro: A station type groups stations with the same prices, e.g. "PS5 Room" or "VIP PC". Each type has its own hourly prices and packages.
stationTypes.ownerOnly: Only owners can change prices. You can view them here.
stationTypes.name: Name
stationTypes.maxPlayersHint: For rooms, prices can depend on how many people play.
stationTypes.activeHint: Turned-off types can't be chosen for new stations. Existing stations and history are kept.

pricing.rulesIntro: Start with a base price for all days and times. Add rules for peak hours, weekends or player counts; when several match, the highest priority wins.
pricing.noRules: No price yet: sessions on this type can't be charged. Add a base price.
pricing.deleteConfirm: Delete this price rule? Bills already made keep their amounts.
pricing.pricePerHourHint: Charged per minute: 30 minutes cost half of this.
pricing.pricePerHourRoomHint: For the whole room, not per player. Charged per minute.
pricing.windowHint: 24-hour clock. If the end is earlier than the start (e.g. 22:00 to 02:00), it runs past midnight and counts as the day it starts.
pricing.playersHint: Leave empty for any number of players.
pricing.priorityHint: When several prices match, the highest number wins. Base price: 0. Peak or weekend: 10.
pricing.validHint: Optional, e.g. for a holiday offer. Leave empty to apply always.
pricing.previewIntro: Try a session and see the price, line by line. Times are in {{timeZone}}.
pricing.previewTooLong: Try a range shorter than 7 days.
pricing.noRate: No price set for this time
pricing.uncoveredWarning: Part of this time has no price, so it is charged 0. Add a base price for all days and times.

packages.title: Hour packages
packages.intro: A fixed price for a number of hours, e.g. 3 hours for 150 EGP. Time after the package is charged at the hourly price.
packages.name: Name
packages.durationHint: e.g. 3:00 for 3 hours, 1:30 for an hour and a half. Up to 24:00.
packages.activeHint: Turned-off packages can't be chosen for new sessions.

stations.title: Stations
stations.empty: No stations in this branch yet.
stations.needTypes: There are no station types yet. Ask the owner to add them.
stations.needTypesOwner: Add a station type first (Settings › Station types & prices).
stations.name: Name or number
stations.countHint: Add several at once: they get numbers after the name.
stations.maintenanceHint: Out of service: it can't be started or booked until you turn this off.
stations.inUseHint: Turn off to remove it from the floor. Its history is kept.

floor.title: Live floor
floor.empty: No stations in this branch yet. Ask your manager or the owner to add them.
floor.emptyCanEdit: No stations in this branch yet. Add them in Settings, Stations.
floor.tapToCheckIn: Tap to check the customer in

sessions.title: Session
sessions.notFound: This session was not found. It may have been removed when the devices synced.

kindHint.open: The timer runs until you end it. The customer pays for the time played.
kindHint.fixed: Pick how long. You get an alert 5 minutes before the end, at the end, and if they run over.

sessions.noRateNow: No price is set for this time. Ask the owner to add a rate rule.
sessions.playersHint: The new player count is priced from now on.
sessions.packageSameType: This session has a package: only stations of the same type
sessions.cancelHint: A cancelled session is not billed. This is recorded with your name.
sessions.endedNotice: Session ended. Take the payment at checkout.
sessions.cancelledNotice: This session was cancelled and will not be billed.
sessions.reservationClash: Reserved at {{time}} {{name}}. This session must end before then, or move the customer.

alerts.body: Planned end {{time}}. Open MyRooms to add time or end the session.
alerts.settingsHint: For fixed-time sessions in the current branch: 5 minutes before the end, at the end, and 15 minutes over. On a computer the app must be open.
alerts.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the device or browser settings.
alerts.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Station cards still change color when time runs out.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.notEnded: This session hasn't ended yet. End it first, then take the payment.
checkout.noBill: This session has no bill yet (it ended before billing was added).
checkout.notPriced: This bill couldn't be priced on this device. The server calculates it when the device is online.
checkout.gapWarning: {{duration}} of this session has no record and was not charged. Check the session history.
checkout.estimateHint: Estimate. The server checks the final amount when this device syncs.
checkout.amountHint: Still to pay: {{due}}. Enter less to split the bill across methods.
checkout.cashReceivedHint: Enter what the customer handed you to see the change.
checkout.referenceHint: Card slip or Instapay transfer number.
checkout.splitHint: The rest can be paid by another method.
checkout.voidHint: A void bill doesn't count as income and can't be paid or changed. This can't be undone and is recorded with your name. Refund any money taken first.

income.title: Income
income.myShiftHint: Only the money you took yourself today. Check the Cash line against your drawer.
income.dateHint: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Both days are included.

rangeError.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date.

income.nothingToday: You haven't taken any payments today.
income.howCounted: Income is the money received minus refunds, on the day it changed hands. Void bills don't count. Payments taken offline on other devices appear once they sync.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.overlapWarning: Some bookings overlap (red border). They were made on two devices while offline; the server will keep only one. Move one of them.
calendar.dayHint: Tap an empty time to book it. Tap a reservation to select it, then drag it to another time or station, or drag its end to change the length. Tap it again to open it.
calendar.dayHintReadOnly: Tap a booking to open it.

reservations.title: Reservation
reservations.cantEdit: Only reservations that have not started can be edited.
reservations.notFound: This reservation was not found. It may have been removed when the devices synced.
reservations.conflict: This station is already booked {{time}}. Pick another time or station.
reservations.openSessionWarning: An open session is running on this station now. Make sure it ends before the reservation.
reservations.checkInHint: Starts the timer now. The session ends at the booked time; you can add time later.
reservations.stationBusy: The booked station is still in use. End or move that session, or check the customer in on another station.
reservations.timeOver: The booked time is over. Cancel it or mark it as a no-show.
reservations.noShowFrom: Can be marked as no-show from {{time}}.

conflicts.title: Not saved ({{count}})
conflicts.hint: The server refused these changes made on this device, usually because another device got there first. Redo them if needed.

modules.off: This module is switched off for your organization. The owner can switch it on in Settings → Organization.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.discountHint: Taken off every bill of this customer automatically (0 = none).
customers.discountOwnerOnly: Only owners and managers can change the discount.
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add them here, or while starting a session or booking.
customers.sessionHint: The customer's default discount is taken off when the session ends.

snacks.title: Snacks & stock
snacks.noProducts: No products yet. The owner adds them in Snacks & stock.
snacks.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from this bill? It goes back into stock.
snacks.outHint: The stock says none are left. You can still add it; correct the count later.
snacks.emptyOwner: No products yet. Add the snacks and drinks you sell.
snacks.name: Name
snacks.trackStockHint: Stock goes down with every sale and up with every restock.
snacks.lowStockAt: Warn when stock is at or below
snacks.hideHint: Products are never deleted, because bills point at them.
snacks.stockHint: Restocks and corrections, minus everything sold in this branch.
snacks.countHint: The difference is saved as a correction.
snacks.countMatches: The count matches the stock. Nothing to correct.

reports.title: Reports
reports.exportFailed: Couldn't export the report. Please try again.

profit.title: Net profit
profit.hint: Net profit is income minus expenses (both by the day they happened).

usage.title: Station usage
usage.heatmapHint: Average number of stations in use, by day and hour. Darker = busier.
usage.peak: Busiest: {{day}} at {{hour}} · stations in use on average: {{busy}}
usage.nothing: No station time in this period.
usage.howCounted: Usage counts the whole day (24 hours), up to now. Cancelled sessions don't count. Stations added during the period count from the day they were added.

customers.title: Top customers
customers.nothing: No payments from saved customers in this period.
customers.hint: Money paid in the period, for sessions linked to a customer.

snacks.title: Snack & drink sales
snacks.hint: Counted on the day they were added to a session. Cancelled sessions and void bills don't count.
